messages:
sophie: Quick design Q — we need guidance on KEK/DEK caching TTL and KMS call throttling for Dedicated + Private. Current thought: cache wrapped DEKs for 30m, refresh KEK sigs every 24h, but KMS unwrap calls only on cache miss. Thoughts?

alex: I'd drop KEK refresh to 12h if we rely on short-lived DEKs. Main tradeoff is auditability vs availability. Frequent unwraps give stronger rotation but hit KMS rate limits.

maria: For regulated customers, ops wants explicit audit trail per decrypt. So we might need an option: 'audit_strict' = true to force KMS audit on every unwrap.

devon: +1. Could add probabilistic sampling for audits to balance cost. Also recommend client-side decrypt cache with LRU and TTL and a global eviction signal on KEK rotation.

sophie: sample config I sketched:
```yaml
encryption:
  dek_cache_ttl: 1800 # seconds
  dek_cache_size: 2000
  kek_rotation_hours: 24
  kms_unwrap_on_miss: true
  audit_mode: sampled # none | sampled | strict
  audit_sample_rate: 0.01
```

maria: For RBAC, we need a new role 'kms-unwrapper' scoped to service accounts that run the runtime, and separate 'kms-auditor' for human operators. Also add condition in IAM to allow unwrap only from specific VPC endpoints.

alex: On AWS KMS we can leverage encryption context to tie requests to tenant id and route. Make sure all unwrap calls include context; log them. Example log line:
`INFO [kms-unwrap] key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234 tenant=acme request_id=xxx outcome=OK`

security-bot: Note: KMS calls are billable — estimated 500k unwraps/month => ~$400. Ops, confirm budget.

devon: On incident response, if KMS becomes unavailable, fallback policy: 1) switch to cached-only mode with readonly degraded ops, 2) fail open? No — prefer fail closed for sensitive writes. Documented in runbook.

sophie: For GCP and Azure mappings: GCP's CMEK has similar context via 'labels', Azure Key Vault supports AAD scopes. We'll add a compatibility layer in the agent.

maria: vuln triage note: if we revoke KEK in KMS, all wrapped DEKs become unreadable — need staged rotation where we create new KEK, rewrap DEKs asynchronously, and then deprecate old KEK after audit window.

alex: Proposed rollout plan: canary rewrap 1% of keys per hour, monitor unwrap success rate and latency, abort if >1% failure.

sophie: Action items: (1) add 'audit_mode' flag and sampling, (2) create IAM proposal for 'kms-unwrapper' + VPC condition, (3) draft runbook for KMS outage. I'll open tickets. @maria @alex assignable?

maria: assigning myself for IAM proposal :thumbsup:

alex: I'll take the rollout automation and sampling work.

kms-audit-bot: New ticket created: #ENGSEC-4923 'KEK/DEK caching & KMS audit mode' by sophie
